basic_info.description: Experience refined city living in this high-floor corner residence with sweeping views of San Francisco and the downtown skyline through floor-to-ceiling windows. This 3BD/2BA home features a bright, open layout, combining modern elegance with thoughtful design. The European-style kitchen shines with StudioBecker cabinetry, Caesarstone counters, full-height backsplash, and premium Thermador and Bosch appliances, all centered around a stylish breakfast bar. Designed for both privacy and effortless flow, this home offers a master suite tucked away in its own wing, featuring dual closets and a spa-like bath with floating double vanity and soaking tub. Across the home, two additional bedrooms provide flexibility. The larger bedroom with Murphy bed and walk-in closet, ideal as a guest room or office. A second bath, Bosch laundry, and ample storage complete the space. Additional highlights include wide-plank wood floors, A/C, and 2-car secured parking. Enjoy top-tier amenities: attended lobby, sky terrace, landscaped courtyard, gym, bike storage, pet spa, and resident lounge. Located in one of SF's most walkable neighborhoods, just steps from Alta Plaza Park, Michelin-starred dining, and boutique shopping on Fillmore and Divisadero, this home defines sophisticated San Francisco living.
